fato_historico: 2004: The Beslan school siege begins when armed terrorists take schoolchildren and school staff hostage in North Ossetia, Russia; by the end of the siege, three days later, more than 385 people are dead (including hostages, other civilians, security personnel and terrorists).
energia_do_dia: The cosmos encourages you to channel your deep empathy today. As history reminds us of how fragile peace can be, perhaps you may choose to light a candle for kindness. It is a good time to focus on healing, fostering unity within your circle, and spreading gentle waves of tranquility to those who need comfort.
frase_do_dia: Kindness is a language that the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
significado_numero: A master number representing spiritual insight and intuitive growth.
conselho: Consider extending a warm, supportive hand to someone struggling in your community today.
